bounds.description: Session 6d (owner's decision: two avenues north of Northern Blvd; east-west bounds stay 73rd-90th St). West 73rd St, east 90th St, north 31st Ave (LION 26C: 32nd Ave and 31st Ave are the first two avenues north of Northern Blvd, each crossing every numbered street from 73rd to 90th St), south Roosevelt Ave plus the station triangle down to Broadway at 74th-75th St. Grid: x = 0 at 73rd St, +1 per numbered street east; y = 0 at 37th Ave, -1 35th Ave, -2 34th Ave, -3 Northern Blvd, -4 32nd Ave, -5 31st Ave, 1 37th Rd, 2 Roosevelt Ave; fractions for Broadway and the streets meeting Roosevelt from the south. Distances are stylized; only order and topology are real. Streets that continue past the bounds (node "continues", each with the first LION segment beyond) are drawn running to the map edge.

layout.description: Session 6e: one continuous map at EarthBound-like building scale (owner's decisions 2 and 3). Tile position of a grid point: x = gridX * tileX (30 tiles per short east-west block, street centre to street centre); y piecewise linear through rowsY ([gridY, tileY] pairs). North-south is capped by the 45 s walk at 150 px/s: corridors keep their width and the long residential blocks take the compression (tools/layout_6e.py has the numbers). halfWidth: corridor half-width in tiles per street, sidewalks included (6d x 3: side streets 6, avenues 9, Northern Blvd and Roosevelt Ave 12). edge: walkable tiles past the outermost nodes, ending at the map-edge barriers. viewMargin: tiles of scenery past that, so the camera never stops scrolling while the player can move. Map tiles = node box + edge + viewMargin on each side (scripts/world-layout.mjs).

transit.name: Jackson Hts-Roosevelt Av / 74 St-Broadway
transit.notes: Elevated 7 platform over Roosevelt Ave plus underground E F M R platforms. Street entrances re-derived from the MTA entrance data: stairs at 73rd St / 37th Rd and 74th St / 37th Rd (north of Roosevelt) and at Broadway / 74th St and Broadway / 75th St (south). 6a's list from search summaries had 74th and 75th St at Roosevelt instead of the 37th Rd and Broadway / 75th St corners. 3 entrance(s) not listed: station houses inside the block between Roosevelt Ave, 74th St, Broadway and 75th St, which 6c draws as a building, not a corner.

transit.notes: Elmhurst Ave meets Roosevelt Ave just east of 90th St, outside the bounds.

areas.name: Jackson Heights Historic District
areas.notes: Segments with at least half their LION length inside the LPC polygon (buffered 5 m). Roughly 77th to 88th St from 37th Ave to 35th Ave, 78th to 87th St up to 34th Ave, and the north side of Roosevelt Ave between about 79th and 85th St. The polygon also takes in parts of the blocks north of 34th Ave at 81st-82nd St (under half of each street's length), which stay outside the bounds.

areas.name: Diversity Plaza
areas.notes: DOT's polygon covers 37th Rd from 73rd to 74th St. LION also codes 73rd St from 37th Rd to Roosevelt Ave as pedestrian-only (seg-73-37rd-roosevelt), but DOT doesn't list it as part of the plaza.

areas.name: Travers Park
areas.notes: Parks: '34 Ave. bet. 77 St. and 78 St.' The park block lies north of 34th Ave between 77th and 78th St; the segments listed are the two that border it inside the bounds.

areas.name: 34th Avenue Open Street (Paseo Park)
areas.notes: DOT's 34th Avenue Open Street: the city's first permanent Open Street, 69th to 96th St (nyc.gov/34ave); DOT's pedestrian plaza polygon runs from 69th to 94th St. Since session 6d the bounds take in 73rd-90th St, all drawn as the paseo. 'Paseo Park' is the community name used by the Alliance for Paseo Park (founded 2023, per DOT). LION 26C still lists most blocks as a street; the dataset draws all of them as plaza (owner's 6c decision).

areas.name: Queens Pride Parade route
areas.notes: 37th Ave from 89th St west to 75th St (2026, DOT closures quoted by CBS). Formation on 89th St (35th Ave to Roosevelt Ave), dispersal on 75th St (37th Ave to Roosevelt Ave), festival on 37th Rd (74th-77th St) and 76th St. The NYPD 2023 advisory lists the route as 79th-89th St but the dispersal at 75th St, so the west end is medium confidence.

zones.name: Roosevelt Avenue
zones.summary: Roosevelt Ave under the elevated 7 from 74th St to 90th St, with the 82 St-Jackson Hts and 90 St-Elmhurst Av stations and the mouths of the streets that meet it from the south.

zones.name: 37th Avenue

Session 6e (owner's decision 13): the flank blocks south of Northern Blvd join the nearest zone.

zones.name: Historic District
zones.summary: The Jackson Heights Historic District and garden co-op blocks north of 37th Ave: 77th to 88th St between 37th Ave and 34th Ave, plus Travers Park and the 78th Street Plaza. Residential blocks stay generic. Session 6e (owner's decision 13): the flank blocks south of Northern Blvd join the nearest zone.

maps.summary: Session 6e: the whole neighborhood as one map at 30 tiles per block, loaded at runtime as an external Tiled file (base64 + zlib layers) and drawn in chunks (owner's decisions 1-3). Every segment of the dataset is on it; zones are named areas on it.

anchors.notes: Where the Dispatcher stands, near the 74 St station (session 6c: the Dispatcher's NPC is placed here by the map generator).

trees.description: Street trees snapped to map tiles of this layout ([column, row] in layout tile coordinates: x = 0 at 73rd St centre line, y = 0 at 37th Ave centre line) and thinned so no two are closer than gapTiles (Chebyshev). Regenerate with tools/derive_6e_data.py when the layout changes.

deviations.subject: area-34th-avenue-plaza
deviations.game: Grassy green surface, car-free and continuous (owner's decision 9).
deviations.reality: Asphalt street with planters, plaza blocks and shared-street blocks (DOT 34th Avenue Open Street).

deviations.subject: area-34th-avenue-plaza
deviations.game: A green painted bike lane along both sides of every block, 73rd to 90th St (owner's decision 9).
deviations.reality: DOT Bike Routes list a current facility on every block (protected, conventional or shared, per direction); blocks marked deviation in bikeLanes have no dedicated lane in both directions in the data.

bikeDocks.description: Bike-share docks at the real station positions inside the walkable area (session 6f, owner's decisions 1-3). Each: the station's GBFS station_id, its corner label as the feed names it, the snapped tile (top-left of the dock, in layout tile coordinates like trees.tiles) and its size [width, height] in tiles: a kiosk plus `slots` bike slots in a row along a curb, the paseo's bike lane or a plaza edge. Regenerate with tools/derive_6f_docks.py.
